title: Anna Karenina Strikes Again: Pre-Trained LLM Embeddings May Favor High-Performing Learners
reasoning: The paper investigates 'discoverability bias' in LLM embeddings within an educational context, specifically how they better represent the responses of high-performing students compared to those with conceptual errors. While it contains an Ethics statement and discusses educational equity, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
